title: Fieldlark
tagline: Wake up the town farm, one field at a time.
shortDescription: Build and grow a 3D farm from above: plant 30 real crops, raise animals, run a mill and a bakery, fill orders for the town and bring back the Harvest Fair.
longDescription: A sleepy community farm needs a new keeper. Plough fields, plant real crops and look after them for better harvests, plant orchards, keep happy animals, and turn your harvest into flour, bread, jam and sweaters. Fill orders for the little river town, trade with friendly neighbour farms, decorate, and win ribbons at the seasonal fairs. There is no energy and nothing ever wilts: farm time only moves while you play.
features: A 3D farm diorama you build and manage from above
30 real crops with a fact for each
Plays with touch, mouse and keyboard, or a gamepad
No energy, no timers, nothing ever wilts
One self-contained HTML file that works offline
contentNotes: Gentle farming with no fighting or scary content. Nothing ever wilts, dies or gets sick, and there are no timers outside play. Some reading, with read-aloud. The farm saves in this browser.

quickStart: Tap an empty field and choose seeds.
Tap ripe crops to pick them, then sell them in the barn.
howToPlay: Tap or click a tile to use it; drag across fields to plant or pick a whole row.
Drag to move around, pinch or scroll to zoom, and twist two fingers or press Q and E to turn.
With a gamepad, move the tile cursor with the left stick, press A to use a tile, and turn with the bumpers.

playTime: About 6–8 hours of story, then endless farming
